cardOverview.overviewText: A lifestyle card providing simple rewards on shopping and dining spends, milestone vouchers, and flexible redemption options for everyday users.

benefitRows.name: Dining
benefitRows.offer: Enjoy a discount of up to 15% on dining across several restaurants under the FedDelights program.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, log in to the FedDelights program portal using your registered account. Browse the available dining and order-in offers, select your favorite meals or restaurants, and apply the benefit at checkout to enjoy 15% off at participating partner hotels. Complete the payment using your Federal Signet credit card to unlock the offer.

benefitRows.name: Insurance
benefitRows.offer: Personal Accident Insurance Cover of 2 Lakhs.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To claim this insurance, report the incident to Federal Bank Customer Care at 1800 420 1199 or 1800 425 1199, or email creditcards@federalbank.co.in. For unauthorized transactions, use the online portal:https://www.federalbank.co.in/block-unauthorised-transactions.. Additionally, file an FIR with the local police station and provide a copy to the bank. The bank will suspend the card upon receiving the report. You may be required to submit additional documents as per the bank's guidelines. For grievance redressal, escalate to the Nodal Officer at creditcardescalation@federalbank.co.in or the Principal Nodal Officer at support@federalbank.co.in.
